usage: Used to refer to the vegetable broccoli.
Commonly found in markets and grocery stores in Hong Kong.
Often cooked by steaming, stir-frying, or boiling.
Describes a fresh, green vegetable with a tree-like shape.
Can be part of healthy meals and is popular with families.
